component.name: Card
component.description: Flexible container component for grouping related content with optional header, footer, tabs, actions, and media.

parts.label: card header
parts.description: Contains title, subtitle, description, badge, icon, and extra content.

parts.label: card content
parts.description: Main content area (children or legacy body prop).

parts.label: card footer
parts.description: Action buttons or custom footer content.

semanticRole.container: article | div (interactive cards may use button role)
semanticRole.title: h2 | h3 | h4 (configurable via titleProps.level)

layout.direction: vertical stack (cover → header → tabs → body → footer)
constraints: Cover image spans full card width (no padding).
Header content wraps on small screens.
Extra content aligns to header trailing edge.
Footer actions wrap if insufficient width.

visualStyle.iconMotion: No icon transitions. Tabs have underline animation.

behavior.map: Card groups related content. Optional header with title/subtitle/description. Optional cover media. Optional tab navigation. Footer with action buttons. Loading skeleton state. Hoverable adds elevation on hover. Interactive/link makes entire card clickable.
behavior.rendering: Header renders if title, subtitle, description, badge, icon, or extra provided. Footer renders if actions or custom footer provided. Tabs render if tabs prop provided.
behavior.defaultState: Outlined variant, medium size, no cover, no tabs, no actions, not loading.

logic.effect: Navigates to link URL or calls onClick callback.
Calls onTabChange with new tab key.

feedback.focus: Focus ring on interactive cards or action buttons.
feedback.disabled: Action buttons can be individually disabled.

states.default: Card displays content with configured styling.
states.loading: Skeleton placeholders replace title, subtitle, body.
states.withTabs: Tabs navigation visible, body shows active tab content.

layout: Cover image spans full card width (ignores padding).
Header extra content aligns to trailing edge.
Footer actions wrap if insufficient width.
content: Title should be concise (1-2 lines ideal).
Body content can be any React nodes.
Actions array max 2-3 buttons for optimal UX.
Tabs max 4-5 for optimal mobile experience.
nesting: Card can contain other Cards (nested cards pattern).
Card should not be nested inside interactive elements (buttons, links).
Footer actions use Button component (already accessible).

aria.label: linkLabel prop provides accessible name for link cards.
aria.labelledby: Title can be referenced by body content if needed.
aria.live: Status message uses aria-live for dynamic updates.

accessibility.keyboard: Interactive cards: Tab to focus, Enter to activate. Action buttons: Tab to focus, Enter/Space to activate. Tabs: Arrow keys navigate.
accessibility.focus: Interactive cards show focus ring. Action buttons have focus indicators.
accessibility.contrast: All text meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 minimum). Status messages use semantic colors with sufficient contrast.

responsiveness.rules: Card width fills parent. Header content wraps on small screens. Extra content moves below title on very small screens. Footer actions stack vertically on mobile.

usageNotes: Use outlined variant for default cards, elevated for prominent cards, filled for subtle cards.
Set hoverable=true for gallery/list items to indicate interactivity.
Use link prop for entire-card navigation, onClick for custom interactions.
Loading state shows skeleton placeholders (title, subtitle, body).
Tabs prop enables in-card navigation (integrates Tabs component).
Actions array creates footer with Button components.
Cover prop for hero images/videos at card top.
Icon can be positioned: start (leading), end (trailing), top (centered above title).
Badge displays in header (position: start or end via badgeProps).
Status message shows success/error/warning/info below header.
Size prop controls padding: S (compact), M (default), L (spacious), full (no padding).
TitleProps, subTitleProps, descriptionProps, bodyProps allow granular typography control.
Extra prop for header trailing content (buttons, badges, metadata).
Footer prop for custom footer content (overrides actions).
